title: Serializable transfers + internal service auth

issues.summary: Idempotency parameter accepted but not used; transfer retry may cause duplicates.
issues.evidence: Function signature includes `idemKey?: string` parameter (visible in diff) but the parameter is never referenced in the transfer logic. Diff shows the function wrapped in withSerializableRetry with maxAttempts: 5, which will re-execute the entire transaction on serialization failure.
issues.scenario: Transfer (acct-1 → acct-2, $100) executed; transaction serialization conflict occurs; withSerializableRetry re-executes the entire transfer logic. If idempotency is not checked (idemKey never used), the same $100 transfer is applied twice: acct-2 receives $200 and acct-1 debited $200. Partner receives duplicate webhook notification.
issues.fix: Author to either: (a) implement idempotency check using idemKey in the transaction, or (b) remove the idemKey parameter and document why idempotency is not needed. If idempotency is enforced elsewhere (e.g., database unique constraint), explain in PR comments.
issues.confirm_or_refute: Full inspection of withSerializableRetry logic and test cases covering duplicate transfer scenarios; check for database-level constraints on (from, to, amount, idemKey) uniqueness or similar.
issues.next_action: Author clarifies idempotency design; provides test case or constraint proof that duplicates are prevented on retry.

issues.summary: Webhook called inside transaction; failure mode unclear.
issues.evidence: Diff shows `await notifyTransfer(from, to, amount)` at line 37, inside the SERIALIZABLE transaction before final return. If webhook fails, transaction state is unclear (rollback not shown in diff).
issues.scenario: Transaction commits and notifyTransfer is called. Webhook delivery to partner fails (network, timeout, 500 error). Partner does not receive the notification. Next retry of same transfer would call notifyTransfer again. If not idempotent, partner sees duplicate events. Conversely, if transaction is rolled back due to webhook error, transfer is not applied but partner may have received partial notification.
issues.fix: Author to either: (a) move notifyTransfer outside the transaction (accept async eventual consistency), (b) ensure notifyTransfer is idempotent and document partner-side idempotency requirement, or (c) use a transactional outbox pattern with a separate notification worker.
issues.confirm_or_refute: Check full withSerializableRetry implementation to see if webhook errors trigger rollback; verify partner webhook handler is idempotent; read tests for webhook failure scenarios.
issues.next_action: Reviewer to inspect full transaction logic and webhook error handling; author to document the contract with partner service.
